## Amendments to framework rules

- **AGE-B4-01**: adds sources PT-LEI58. Portugal: age of digital consent is 13 (Lei 58/2019, art. 16). Below 13, consent-based processing needs guardian authorisation.
- **CORE-DAT-11**: adds sources PT-LEI58. Portugal: guardian consent is needed below 13 where consent is the legal basis.
- **CORE-DAT-01**: adds sources PT-CNPD. Portugal: check the CNPD list of operations that always require a DPIA. In public school deployments the school or Ministry is usually the controller.
- **CORE-ACC-01**: adds sources PT-DL83; sets level 1. Portugal: products delivered to public schools or other public bodies must meet DL 83/2018, including an accessibility statement.
- **CORE-SAF-06**: adds sources PT-ISEGURA. Portugal: show Linha Internet Segura (800 21 90 90) in help and support screens.
- **CORE-SEC-05**: adds sources PT-CNPD. Portugal: personal data breaches are notified to the CNPD by the controller within 72 hours.
- **CORE-COM-03**: adds 1 detection pattern(s). 

## Rules added

### PT-LNG-01: Child-facing information in European Portuguese

**MUST** · Level 3 (Best practice) · Age bands: all · Detection: manual · Effort: medium

**Requirement.** Everything a child in Portugal reads or hears (instructions, settings, warnings, privacy notice, reporting tools) is available in European Portuguese, written for the target age.

**Why.** KIDS Act Art. 18 and 19 require information minors can understand. For VLOPs it requires the official language of the Member State; for everyone else it is best practice.

**How to improve.** Add PT-PT copy for all child-facing text and have it reviewed by an instructional designer.

**Sources.** [KIDS](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:52026PC0681)

### PT-SUP-01: Help screens point to Portuguese support services

**SHOULD** · Level 2 (Forward-compliant) · Age bands: all · Features: multiplayer, chat, ugc, social, ai_generative · Detection: manual · Effort: low

**Requirement.** Support information after a report includes Portuguese resources (Linha Internet Segura) and explains in simple words how to get help from a trusted adult.

**Why.** KIDS Act Art. 19(4) requires informing minors of national support organisations.

**How to improve.** Add the Linha Internet Segura number and link to the help screen.

**Sources.** [KIDS](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:52026PC0681), [PT-ISEGURA](https://www.internetsegura.pt)
